section.title: Popular Direct Mail Formats
section.description: We custom print and process several major mail styles. Tailor dimensions, paper weights, and folding specifications for your unique branding goals.
section.note: Core fields (title, description, sizes/options/details/features) are sourced directly from the live page. Supplemental fields below (turnaround, paper stock, pricing tier, FAQs, etc.) are reasonable industry-standard additions not published on the source page — verify with FBS Signs before using as-is.

formats.title: Postcards
formats.description: Perfect for quick product announcements, coupon discounts, and retail store openings. Extremely cost-effective.

faqs.question: Do I need a mailing list to send postcards?
faqs.answer: No — EDDM lets you target every address on a mail route without buying a list, so you can launch a campaign with zero data on hand.

faqs.question: Which postcard size gets the best response rate?
faqs.answer: 6"x9" is our most requested size — it's big enough to stand out in the mailbox while still qualifying for EDDM and bulk mail rates.

faqs.question: What's the smallest order I can place?
faqs.answer: Runs start at 500 pieces. That keeps your per-piece cost low while still hitting the minimum for EDDM and USPS Marketing Mail pricing.

faqs.question: Can you design the postcard for me, or do I need my own artwork?
faqs.answer: Either works. Send print-ready files, or our in-house design team can build the layout from scratch based on your branding and offer.

faqs.question: How soon can I expect delivery after I approve my proof?
faqs.answer: Standard turnaround is 3-5 business days from proof approval to mail drop, depending on quantity and your chosen mail class.

faqs.question: Will a glossy finish smear or crack if it's folded in transit?
faqs.answer: No — our 14pt gloss and matte stocks are coated to resist scuffing and moisture, and they hold up fine through standard USPS handling.

formats.title: Letter Mailers
formats.description: Ideal for business letters, newsletters, utility notices, and solicitations. Keeps your communications secure.
formats.detailsValue: Single window, Double window, reply envelope
formats.printSides: Full color or black & white, single or double-sided

faqs.question: Can every letter show a different name or account number?
faqs.answer: Yes — variable data printing personalizes names, account numbers, balances, and offers on each letter without slowing down the print run.

faqs.question: Do you handle folding, stuffing, and sealing for me?
faqs.answer: Yes — folding, insertion, and sealing are all done in-house as part of production, so letters arrive ready to mail.

faqs.question: Can I include a reply envelope for payments or donations?
faqs.answer: Yes — a reply envelope can be inserted alongside your letter, ideal for billing statements, fundraising appeals, or returned forms.

faqs.question: What's the difference between single and double window envelopes?
faqs.answer: Single window shows just the recipient address; double window also displays a return address or account number printed on the letter itself.

faqs.question: Is my recipient's information kept secure during printing?
faqs.answer: Yes — we use tamper-evident sealing and controlled production runs, which is standard practice for utility notices and financial correspondence.

faqs.question: How small can a test batch be before I commit to a full mailing?
faqs.answer: Minimum orders start at 250 pieces, letting you validate messaging and personalization accuracy before scaling to your full list.

formats.title: Catalogs & Booklets
formats.description: Saddle-stitched or perfect bound booklets are fantastic for showcasing complete product ranges or seasonal guides.
formats.detailsValue: Coated or uncoated stock, up to 64 pages

faqs.question: Should I choose saddle-stitch or perfect binding for my catalog?
faqs.answer: Saddle-stitch staples folded sheets and works well for thinner booklets; perfect binding glues a flat spine and suits thicker, higher-page catalogs.

faqs.question: Is there a maximum page count I need to stay under?
faqs.answer: 64 pages is our standard maximum for this format. Higher page counts can still be produced — just ask for a custom quote.

faqs.question: Can I print a short test run before ordering the full quantity?
faqs.answer: Yes — short runs starting at 250 copies let you proof layout, binding, and paper stock before committing to a larger print order.

faqs.question: What paper stock is best for a premium look and feel?
faqs.answer: 100lb gloss cover on the outside with 80lb gloss text inside gives a durable, upscale finish that photographs and handles well.

faqs.question: Will USPS accept a bound catalog as a standard mail piece?
faqs.answer: Yes — catalogs ship under USPS Marketing Mail Flat or Bound Printed Matter classes, both built specifically for multi-page bound pieces.

faqs.question: How long does production take for a 64-page catalog run?
faqs.answer: Plan on 7-10 business days from final proof approval, which covers printing, binding, trimming, and quality checks before your run ships.

formats.title: Folded Self-Mailers
formats.description: Bi-fold, tri-fold, or gate-folded print designs that seal with clear wafer tabs. No envelope needed.

faqs.question: Do I need an envelope to mail a folded self-mailer?
faqs.answer: No — clear wafer seals hold the folded panels shut, so the piece travels through USPS on its own without any envelope.

faqs.question: Can recipients tear off a coupon or reply card?
faqs.answer: Yes — perforated panels let recipients detach a coupon, reply card, or offer slip while keeping the rest of the mailer intact.

faqs.question: Which fold type fits my content best — bi-fold, tri-fold, or gate-fold?
faqs.answer: Bi-folds suit simple two-panel offers, tri-folds fit brochure-style layouts, and gate-folds give you the most panels for multi-product spreads.

faqs.question: Will the wafer seals hold up through automated mail sorting?
faqs.answer: Yes — our wafer tabbing meets USPS mailing standards and is tested to stay sealed through automated sorting and delivery equipment.

faqs.question: How many panels can I design across a gate-fold layout?
faqs.answer: A standard gate-fold gives you up to six usable panels, ideal for showcasing multiple products or a step-by-step offer sequence.

faqs.question: What's the production timeline compared to a simple postcard?
faqs.answer: Folded self-mailers take 5-7 business days due to the added folding and wafer-sealing steps, versus 3-5 days for flat postcards.
